 Amid dengue outbreak, St. Pete residents wonder: Is a tire shop spreading it? 
 St. Petersburg filed an injunction against a used tire shop this week, arguing it was a sanitary nuisance.     .   A photo taken on April 15 during a St. Petersburg codes case shows tires stacked outside at Thach Tire & Rim, 1445 16th St. N. This week, the city filed an injunction against the tire shop, arguing it was a public sanitary nuisance. [ The city of St. Petersburg ] Michaela Mulligan is a climate and environment reporter.
